fact: The NRB principal secretary said nine national IDs issued illegally to refugees were confiscated, and that the Registration Act has no mandate to register refugees.
UNHCR reports the National Registration Bureau announced plans to register and issue ID cards to refugees and asylum-seekers in Malawi.
UNHCR reports more than 1,100 asylum-seekers from Mozambique registered in Malawi's Nsanje District by end of December 2024, with no documents stated.
